title: Ibicuruzwa byatumijwe
salesAndDeliveryDescription: Ibicuruzwa wagurishije n’intambwe zikurikizwa kuva aho bifatirwa kugeza ku muguzi.
myPurchasesDescription: Ibicuruzwa wishyuye n’aho buri tumiza rigeze mu nzira yo kubikugezaho.
paymentHeldDescription: Amafaranga yishyuwe n’umuguzi abikwa kugeza ibicuruzwa bigejejwe aho bigomba kugera. Ubwikorezi bufungurwa ku giciro gikalkuliwe na Pinza.
awaitingLogisticsDescription: Abashinzwe ubwikorezi bashobora kwemera igiciro cyagenewe. Nta cyifuzo cy’ubwikorezi gikenewe kuva kuri wowe.
acceptQuoteDescription: Hitamo utwara ibicuruzwa. Kumwemeza bitangiza gahunda yo kubigeza ku muguzi.
packagingDescription: Abashinzwe ubwikorezi nibabigusaba, emeza ko ibicuruzwa byapakiwe.
inTransitDescription: Nyuma yo kwemeza ko ibicuruzwa byapakiwe, bigaragazwa nk’ibiri mu nzira.
packagingConfirmedInTransit: Byemejwe ko ibicuruzwa byapakiwe. Ubu biri mu nzira.
sellerPayoutSummary: Umuguzi yemeje ko yakiriye ibicuruzwa. Uhabwa {{netAmount}} nyuma yo gukuramo amafaranga ya serivisi y’isoko angana na {{platformFeePercent}}% ({{platformFee}}). Ubwikorezi ({{deliveryFee}}) bwishyuwe n’umuguzi.
purchaseTrackingEmpty: Ibicuruzwa wamaze kwishyura bizagaragara hano, hamwe n’amakuru yo gukurikirana aho bigeze.
